meta.title: Greenwood Apartments Odessa — Luxury Apartments in the Heart of Odessa
meta.description: Greenwood Apartments — luxury apartments in the heart of Odessa. Online booking and payment, panoramic views, concierge service.

hero.title: Greenwood Apartments
hero.subtitle: Quiet luxury in Odessa's greenest quarter — steps from the sea and Deribasovskaya Street

about.title: A home among the greenery, in the heart of the city
about.text: Greenwood Apartments is a collection of eight premium residences in Odessa's historic quarter, where 19th-century architecture meets modern comfort. We created a space for those who value quiet, privacy and attention to detail — from natural finishing materials to a personal concierge who resolves any request within the day.

rooms.title: Choose your apartment
rooms.subtitle: Every room is individually designed — natural wood, linen textiles and panoramic windows

items.name: Studio Garden
items.description: A cozy studio overlooking the courtyard garden, with a kitchenette and a terrace for morning coffee.

items.name: One Bedroom Deluxe
items.description: A spacious bedroom, separate living room and a fully equipped kitchen — perfect for extended stays.

items.name: Executive Suite
items.description: Apartment overlooking the dome of the Transfiguration Cathedral, with a spa bathroom and a dedicated workspace.

items.name: Greenwood Penthouse
items.description: A two-level top-floor penthouse with a private terrace and sea views — our flagship room.

items.title: 24/7 Concierge
items.description: Transfers, restaurants, tours — arranged any time of day

items.title: Private Parking
items.description: Secure parking in the residence's inner courtyard

items.title: High-Speed Wi-Fi
items.description: Fiber internet up to 500 Mbps in every apartment

items.title: Breakfast in Room
items.description: Fresh pastries and local farm produce every morning

items.title: Spa & Massage
items.description: Partner spa center a 5-minute walk away

items.title: Airport Transfer
items.description: We'll meet you and drive you in a comfortable car

items.title: Pet Friendly
items.description: Your pets are welcome by prior arrangement

items.name: Marina K.
items.text: The best apartments I've stayed in in Odessa. Service level of a five-star hotel with the warmth of a home.

items.name: Thomas R.
items.text: Immaculate design, incredibly quiet despite being in the city center. The concierge team went above and beyond.

items.name: Olena V.
items.text: The penthouse exceeded every expectation — the morning sea view is unforgettable. We'll definitely be back.

location.title: In the heart of historic Odessa
location.text: We're tucked in a quiet lane two minutes from Primorsky Boulevard and the Opera House, 350 meters from the beach — surrounded by the city's best restaurants, galleries and boutiques.
